verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly accepts the immediately preceding proposal to place the ESP32 at the PCB edge, establishing an RF/mechanical placement constraint.
The message proposes a cost-optimized single-board architecture but does not mention or modify ESP32 antenna placement or clearance.
The client explicitly requires the ESP32-S3 antenna to face away from the battery and have at least 3 mm of keepout on the integrated board.
The message leaves unresolved whether components may occupy the recommended secondary antenna-clear area despite the resulting WiFi-range reduction.
